audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Joshua / Yehoshua Judah boundary, Caleb-Debir, Achsah springs, city-list, and Jebusite-remnant register, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for Judah's south/east/north/west borders, Hebron/Anakim, Debir conquest prize, Achsah's land-and-water request, regional city lists and totals, Philistine coastal cities, and Jerusalem's continuing Jebusite population.

verses.restored: Lot for tribe of sons of Judah according to their clans was toward border of Edom, wilderness of Zin southward, at extreme south.

familiar.text: This then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families; even to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward was the uttermost part of the south coast.

modern.text: Now the allotment for the clans of the tribe of Judah extended to the border of Edom, to the Wilderness of Zin at the extreme southern boundary:

original.text: וַיְהִ֣י הַגּוֹרָ֗ל לְמַטֵּ֛ה בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם אֶל גְּב֨וּל אֱד֧וֹם מִדְבַּר צִ֛ן נֶ֖גְבָּה מִקְצֵ֥ה תֵימָֽן

verses.restored: Their south border was from end of Salt Sea, from bay that faces southward.

familiar.text: And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea, from the bay that looketh southward:

modern.text: Their southern border started at the bay on the southern tip of the Salt Sea,

original.text: וַיְהִ֤י לָהֶם֙ גְּב֣וּל נֶ֔גֶב מִקְצֵ֖ה יָ֣ם הַמֶּ֑לַח מִן הַלָּשֹׁ֖ן הַפֹּנֶ֥ה נֶֽגְבָּה

verses.restored: It went out south of ascent of Akrabbim, passed to Zin, went up south of Kadesh-barnea, passed Hezron, went up to Addar, and turned toward Karka.

familiar.text: And it went out to the south side to Maalehacrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and ascended up on the south side unto Kadeshbarnea, and passed along to Hezron, and went up to Adar, and fetched a compass to Karkaa:

modern.text: proceeded south of the Ascent of Akrabbim, continued on to Zin, went over to the south of Kadesh-barnea, ran past Hezron up to Addar, and curved toward Karka.

original.text: וְ֠יָצָא אֶל מִנֶּ֜גֶב לְמַעֲלֵ֤ה עַקְרַבִּים֙ וְעָ֣בַר צִ֔נָה וְעָלָ֥ה מִנֶּ֖גֶב לְקָדֵ֣שׁ בַּרְנֵ֑עַ וְעָבַ֤ר חֶצְרוֹן֙ וְעָלָ֣ה אַדָּ֔רָה וְנָסַ֖ב הַקַּרְקָֽעָה

verses.restored: It passed toward Azmon, went out to wadi of Egypt, and border's end was sea. This shall be your south border.

familiar.text: From thence it passed toward Azmon, and went out unto the river of Egypt; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea: this shall be your south coast.

modern.text: It proceeded to Azmon, joined the Brook of Egypt, and ended at the Sea. This was their southern border.

original.text: וְעָבַ֣ר עַצְמ֗וֹנָה וְיָצָא֙ נַ֣חַל מִצְרַ֔יִם והיה תֹּצְא֥וֹת הַגְּב֖וּל יָ֑מָּה זֶה יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם גְּב֥וּל נֶֽגֶב

verses.restored: East border was Salt Sea as far as mouth of Jordan. Border on north side began from bay of sea at mouth of Jordan.

familiar.text: And the east border was the salt sea, even unto the end of Jordan. And their border in the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan:

modern.text: The eastern border was the Salt Sea as far as the mouth of the Jordan. The northern border started from the bay of the sea at the mouth of the Jordan,

original.text: וּגְב֥וּל קֵ֨דְמָה֙ יָ֣ם הַמֶּ֔לַח עַד קְצֵ֖ה הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וּגְב֞וּל לִפְאַ֤ת צָפ֨וֹנָה֙ מִלְּשׁ֣וֹן הַיָּ֔ם מִקְצֵ֖ה הַיַּרְדֵּֽן

verses.restored: Border went up to Beth-hoglah, passed north of Beth-arabah, and went up to Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.

familiar.text: And the border went up to Bethhogla, and passed along by the north of Betharabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben:

modern.text: went up to Beth-hoglah, proceeded north of Beth-arabah, and went up to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.

original.text: וְעָלָ֤ה הַגְּבוּל֙ בֵּ֣ית חָגְלָ֔ה וְעָבַ֕ר מִצְּפ֖וֹן לְבֵ֣ית הָעֲרָבָ֑ה וְעָלָ֣ה הַגְּב֔וּל אֶ֥בֶן בֹּ֖הַן בֶּן רְאוּבֵֽן

verses.restored: Border went up to Debir from Valley of Achor and northward toward Gilgal, opposite ascent of Adummim south of wadi; border passed to waters of En-shemesh and its end was at En-rogel.

familiar.text: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that is before the going up to Adummim, which is on the south side of the river: and the border passed toward the waters of Enshemesh, and the goings out thereof were at Enrogel:

modern.text: Then the border went up to Debir from the Valley of Achor, turning north to Gilgal, which faces the Ascent of Adummim south of the ravine. It continued along the waters of En-shemesh and came out at En-rogel.

original.text: וְעָלָ֨ה הַגְּב֥וּל דְּבִרָה֮ מֵעֵ֣מֶק עָכוֹר֒ וְצָפ֜וֹנָה פֹּנֶ֣ה אֶל הַגִּלְגָּ֗ל אֲשֶׁר נֹ֨כַח֙ לְמַעֲלֵ֣ה אֲדֻמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִנֶּ֖גֶב לַנָּ֑חַל וְעָבַ֤ר הַגְּבוּל֙ אֶל מֵי עֵ֣ין שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ וְהָי֥וּ תֹצְאֹתָ֖יו אֶל עֵ֥ין רֹגֵֽל

verses.restored: Border went up by Valley of son of Hinnom to southern shoulder of Jebusite, that is Jerusalem; border went up to top of mountain facing Valley of Hinnom westward, at north end of Valley of Rephaim.

familiar.text: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite; the same is Jerusalem: and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lieth before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the end of the valley of the giants northward:

modern.text: From there the border went up the Valley of Hinnom along the southern slope of the Jebusites (that is, Jerusalem) and ascended to the top of the hill that faces the Valley of Hinnom on the west, at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim.

original.text: וְעָלָ֨ה הַגְּב֜וּל גֵּ֣י בֶן הִנֹּ֗ם אֶל כֶּ֤תֶף הַיְבוּסִי֙ מִנֶּ֔גֶב הִ֖יא יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְעָלָ֨ה הַגְּב֜וּל אֶל רֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֗ר אֲ֠שֶׁר עַל פְּנֵ֤י גֵֽי הִנֹּם֙ יָ֔מָּה אֲשֶׁ֛ר בִּקְצֵ֥ה עֵֽמֶק רְפָאִ֖ים צָפֹֽנָה

verses.restored: Border was marked from top of mountain to spring of waters of Nephtoah, went out to cities of Mount Ephron, and was marked to Baalah, that is Kiriath-jearim.

familiar.text: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border was drawn to Baalah, which is Kirjathjearim:

modern.text: From the hilltop the border curved to the spring of the Waters of Nephtoah, proceeded to the cities of Mount Ephron, and then bent around toward Baalah (that is, Kiriath-jearim).

original.text: וְתָאַ֨ר הַגְּב֜וּל מֵרֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֗ר אֶל מַעְיַן֙ מֵ֣י נֶפְתּ֔וֹחַ וְיָצָ֖א אֶל עָרֵ֣י הַר עֶפְר֑וֹן וְתָאַ֤ר הַגְּבוּל֙ בַּעֲלָ֔ה הִ֖יא קִרְיַ֥ת יְעָרִֽים

verses.restored: Border turned from Baalah westward to Mount Seir, passed to northern shoulder of Mount Jearim, that is Chesalon, went down to Beth-shemesh, and passed Timnah.

familiar.text: And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir, and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim, which is Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Bethshemesh, and passed on to Timnah:

modern.text: The border curled westward from Baalah to Mount Seir, ran along the northern slope of Mount Jearim (that is, Chesalon), went down to Beth-shemesh, and crossed to Timnah.

original.text: וְנָסַב֩ הַגְּב֨וּל מִבַּעֲלָ֥ה יָ֨מָּה֙ אֶל הַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֔יר וְעָבַ֕ר אֶל כֶּ֧תֶף הַר יְעָרִ֛ים מִצָּפ֖וֹנָה הִ֣יא כְסָל֑וֹן וְיָרַ֥ד בֵּֽית שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ וְעָבַ֥ר תִּמְנָֽה

verses.restored: Border went out to northern shoulder of Ekron, was marked toward Shikkeron, passed Mount Baalah, and went out to Jabneel; border's end was sea.

familiar.text: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward: and the border was drawn to Shicron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out unto Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.

modern.text: Then it went out to the northern slope of Ekron, curved toward Shikkeron, proceeded to Mount Baalah, went on to Jabneel, and ended at the Sea.

original.text: וְיָצָ֨א הַגְּב֜וּל אֶל כֶּ֣תֶף עֶקְרוֹן֮ צָפוֹנָה֒ וְתָאַ֤ר הַגְּבוּל֙ שִׁכְּר֔וֹנָה וְעָבַ֥ר הַר הַֽבַּעֲלָ֖ה וְיָצָ֣א יַבְנְאֵ֑ל וְהָי֛וּ תֹּצְא֥וֹת הַגְּב֖וּל יָֽמָּה

verses.restored: West border was Great Sea and its coast. This was border around sons of Judah according to their clans.

familiar.text: And the west border was to the great sea, and the coast thereof. This is the coast of the children of Judah round about according to their families.

modern.text: And the western border was the coastline of the Great Sea. These are the boundaries around the clans of the descendants of Judah. Caleb’s Portion and Conquest (Judges 1:8–26)

original.text: וּגְב֣וּל יָ֔ם הַיָּ֥מָּה הַגָּד֖וֹל וּגְב֑וּל זֶ֠ה גְּב֧וּל בְּנֵֽי יְהוּדָ֛ה סָבִ֖יב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם

verses.restored: To Caleb son of Jephunneh Joshua gave a portion in midst of sons of Judah according to command of YHWH to Joshua: Kiriath-arba, father of Anak, that is Hebron.

familiar.text: And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua, even the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron.

modern.text: According to the LORD’s command to him, Joshua gave Caleb son of Jephunneh a portion among the sons of Judah—Kiriath-arba, that is, Hebron. (Arba was the forefather of Anak.)

original.text: וּלְכָלֵ֣ב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּ֗ה נָ֤תַן חֵ֨לֶק֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ בְּנֵֽי יְהוּדָ֔ה אֶל פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לִֽיהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ אֶת קִרְיַ֥ת אַרְבַּ֛ע אֲבִ֥י הָעֲנָ֖ק הִ֥יא חֶבְרֽוֹן

verses.restored: Caleb dispossessed from there three sons of Anak: Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai, children of Anak.

familiar.text: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.

modern.text: And Caleb drove out from there the three sons of Anak—the descendants of Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.

original.text: וַיֹּ֤רֶשׁ מִשָּׁם֙ כָּלֵ֔ב אֶת שְׁלוֹשָׁ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י הָעֲנָ֑ק אֶת שֵׁשַׁ֤י וְאֶת אֲחִימַן֙ וְאֶת תַּלְמַ֔י יְלִידֵ֖י הָעֲנָֽק

verses.restored: He went up from there against inhabitants of Debir; name of Debir formerly was Kiriath-sepher.

familiar.text: And he went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjathsepher.

modern.text: From there he marched against the inhabitants of Debir (formerly known as Kiriath-sepher).

original.text: וַיַּ֣עַל מִשָּׁ֔ם אֶל יֹשְׁבֵ֖י דְּבִ֑ר וְשֵׁם דְּבִ֥ר לְפָנִ֖ים קִרְיַת סֵֽפֶר

verses.restored: Caleb said, Whoever strikes Kiriath-sepher and captures it, I will give him Achsah my daughter as wife.

familiar.text: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjathsepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.

modern.text: And Caleb said, “To the man who strikes down Kiriath-sepher and captures it, I will give my daughter Acsah in marriage.”

original.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר כָּלֵ֔ב אֲשֶׁר יַכֶּ֥ה אֶת קִרְיַת סֵ֖פֶר וּלְכָדָ֑הּ וְנָתַ֥תִּי ל֛וֹ אֶת עַכְסָ֥ה בִתִּ֖י לְאִשָּֽׁה

verses.restored: Othniel son of Kenaz, brother of Caleb, captured it, and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.

familiar.text: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.

modern.text: So Othniel son of Caleb’s brother Kenaz captured the city, and Caleb gave his daughter Acsah to him in marriage.

original.text: וַֽיִּלְכְּדָ֛הּ עָתְנִיאֵ֥ל בֶּן קְנַ֖ז אֲחִ֣י כָלֵ֑ב וַיִּתֶּן ל֛וֹ אֶת עַכְסָ֥ה בִתּ֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה

verses.restored: It was, when she came, that she urged him to ask from her father a field; then she dismounted from donkey, and Caleb said to her, What is for you?

familiar.text: And it came to pass, as she came unto him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wouldest thou?

modern.text: One day Acsah came to Othniel and urged him to ask her father for a field. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, “What do you desire?”

original.text: וַיְהִ֣י בְּבוֹאָ֗הּ וַתְּסִיתֵ֨הוּ֙ לִשְׁא֤וֹל מֵֽאֵת אָבִ֨יהָ֙ שָׂדֶ֔ה וַתִּצְנַ֖ח מֵעַ֣ל הַחֲמ֑וֹר וַיֹּֽאמֶר לָ֥הּ כָּלֵ֖ב מַה לָּֽךְ

verses.restored: She said, Give me a blessing, for you have given me land of Negev; give me also springs of water. So he gave her upper springs and lower springs.

familiar.text: Who answered, Give me a blessing; for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs, and the nether springs.

modern.text: “Give me a blessing,” she answered. “Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me springs of water as well.” So Caleb gave her both the upper and lower springs. The Cities of Judah

original.text: וַתֹּ֜אמֶר תְּנָה לִּ֣י בְרָכָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֶ֤רֶץ הַנֶּ֨גֶב֙ נְתַתָּ֔נִי וְנָתַתָּ֥ה לִ֖י גֻּלֹּ֣ת מָ֑יִם וַיִּתֶּן לָ֗הּ אֵ֚ת גֻּלֹּ֣ת עִלִּיּ֔וֹת וְאֵ֖ת גֻּלֹּ֥ת תַּחְתִּיּֽוֹת

verses.restored: This is inheritance of tribe of sons of Judah according to their clans.

familiar.text: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.

modern.text: This is the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Judah.

original.text: זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי יְהוּדָ֖ה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם

verses.restored: Cities at extreme end of tribe of sons of Judah toward border of Edom in south were Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,

familiar.text: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,

modern.text: These were the southernmost cities of the tribe of Judah in the Negev toward the border of Edom: Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,

familiar.text: And Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,

modern.text: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,

verses.restored: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,

familiar.text: And Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,

modern.text: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,

familiar.text: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth,

modern.text: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,

verses.restored: Hazor-hadattah, Kerioth-hezron, that is Hazor,

familiar.text: And Hazargaddah, and Heshmon, and Bethpalet,

modern.text: Hazar-gaddah, Heshmon, Beth-pelet,

original.text: וַחֲצַ֥ר גַּדָּ֛ה וְחֶשְׁמ֖וֹן וּבֵ֥ית פָּֽלֶט

familiar.text: And Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,

translation_notes: Judah's boundary description uses ancient landmarks, wadis, springs, ridges, and renamed towns whose exact identifications are often uncertain.
The border register is historical geography, not a modern political border or title document.
Caleb's capture of Hebron and Othniel's capture of Debir remain conquest stories involving existing Anakim and city populations.

Achsah is transferred as a marriage reward within a patriarchal arrangement, yet she speaks directly, requests a blessing, and secures both upper and lower springs. Her agency should be honored without romanticizing the system that treats her marriage as a prize.
Water transforms dry land into viable inheritance; Achsah's request reveals that land without resources is not a meaningful gift.
The city totals do not always align neatly with the names preserved in the Masoretic text, and Septuagintal witnesses include notable variants and additions, especially around verse 59.
Ekron, Ashdod, and Gaza appear in Judah's allotment despite continuing Philistine presence, showing the difference between assigned territory and actual control.
The final verse explicitly says Jebusites remain in Jerusalem, contradicting simplistic claims of complete dispossession and preserving a mixed-city reality.
safety_note: Do not use Joshua 15 as a modern border charter, to justify conquest, to treat women as rewards, or to erase Jebusite and Philistine inhabitants. Center Achsah's direct demand for life-giving water, the difference between allocation and possession, and the text's admission that Jerusalem remained shared.
